print_errors.text: (قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ ثُمَّ ذَرْهُمْ فِى خَوْضِهِمْ يَلْعَبُونَ (٩١)﴾
print_errors.note: The opening bracket of the al-An'am 91 quotation is printed as a plain round parenthesis '(' instead of the ornate ﴿ (the closing ﴾ is ornate). Transcribed as ﴿…﴾ per CONVENTIONS §3.

notes: p.005: starts with the heading «مقدِّمة» (shadda+kasra on dal), so there is no '+' on the marker. p.004 ends with a complete salawat line and has no footnotes. Throughout pp.005-008 the body font prints a small dagger alif over final alef maqsura in على/إلى/حتى/أخرى/الحسنى/أرجى. Because it is a visible printed mark, it is written ىٰ (U+0649 U+0670). The bold «على الله» on p.006 has no dagger and is written plain. p.006: «شعارنا ومنهج حياتنا:» is ### (STRUCTURE §2). مذهبنا:/طريقتنا:/عقيدتنا: are written as run-in bold labels joined to the next printed line, following the explicit example in CONVENTIONS §6 and STRUCTURE §3, even though the print sets each label on its own larger bold line. The statements after them are also printed bold (in contrast to the regular explanatory lines «أي…», «النصر مع الصبر», «(رحمتك…)»), so they get their own **…**. Item numbers (١)-(٥) are kept outside the bold so they are not read as glued footnote references. The references [الزمر:١٠] and [الأنعام:٩١] are printed bold, [آل عمران:٢٠٠] regular and smaller. All three are printed with no space after the colon and are kept that way. The silent alif on واْ in 3:200 is the round zero (U+06DF), and فِى in 6:91 is printed without dots. The ornament flowers on the brackets are dropped. scripts\quran.py reports no flags. p.007: the photos are omitted. Each centered caption is one paragraph, right caption first. The stretched «هـ» after the hijri years is written «ه» because tatweel is dropped (§2, which the validator enforces). «عبد الله» in the left caption has a visible space. p.008: the 2-line title is one # heading. «عبدالله» is written without a space, following the STRUCTURE heading map; in the condensed title font the gap is ambiguous. The shadda and kasra in «الصِّديق» both sit on the ṣād (dal unmarked, checked at 2000 dpi). The رضي الله عنه glyph becomes (رضي الله عنه). «قائلا :» is printed with a space before the colon and normalized to «قائلا:» per §2 spacing. «رحمه الله» is printed as ordinary words. The page ends mid-sentence («…وأبو الحسن الشاذلي،»), so p.009 should start with a '+' marker. The footnote «(١) القرويين: …» has no final period in print.
